title: Braised Cabbage Boregi
description: A French twist on traditional Turkish boregi, featuring tender braised cabbage and crispy phyllo.
instructions: In a large pan, heat olive oil over medium heat.
Add garlic and onion, cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add shredded cabbage and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 15-20 minutes.
Stir in chicken broth and caraway seeds. Bring to a simmer.
Cut phyllo dough into desired size for boregi.
Layer phyllo dough in a greased 9x13-inch baking dish.
Spoon cabbage mixture onto phyllo, leaving a 1-inch border.
Brush edges of phyllo with olive oil.
Fold phyllo over filling and press edges to seal.
Brush top of boregi with olive oil and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve warm, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
